reason: I'm not linking my bank account to a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews. I might download the free version to poke around, but I'd never pay for a utility app when there's a free one.
objection: I do not want to link my bank account to an unknown app. If one solo developer gets hacked or just disappears, my financial data goes with them.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of real reviews from people like me, plus the free version working fully without linking my bank, so I could try it for a couple of months first.
